tasks.title: Create beach-personalities.ts static data file
tasks.objective: Create client/src/data/beach-personalities.ts with BeachPersonality interface, BeachVibe type, and personality data for all 9 Vancouver beaches. This static data provides personality archetypes, taglines, editorial descriptions, differentiators, vibe tags, Instagram hashtags, and accent colors.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: BeachPersonality interface has slug, archetype, tagline, editorial, differentiators (string[]), vibes (BeachVibe[]), instagramHashtag, instagramPostUrls (string[]), and accentColor fields
BeachVibe type includes: 'active', 'quiet', 'family', 'dog-friendly', 'sunset', 'social', 'nature', 'urban'
beachPersonalities array contains entries for all 9 beaches with slugs matching existing beach data
getPersonality(slug) helper function returns the matching personality or undefined

tasks.technical_notes: Slugs must match the beach IDs used in the shared BEACHES array. Use descriptive archetypes that capture each beach's unique personality. Include 2-3 differentiators per beach. Each beach should have 2-4 vibes assigned. instagramPostUrls is an array of curated Instagram post URLs for the oEmbed fallback (start with 4-6 per beach, can use placeholder URLs). The getPersonality helper enables easy lookup from components.

tasks.title: Create verdict computation utility
tasks.objective: Create client/src/utils/verdict.ts with the BeachVerdict interface and computeVerdict function that synthesizes existing weather, tide, and sun time data into a narrative recommendation (recommendation level, summary text, best time window, reasons array, and suggestion).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: BeachVerdict interface has recommendation ('perfect'|'good'|'fair'|'skip'), summary (string), bestTimeWindow (string), reasons (string[]), and suggestion (string)
acceptance_criteria.test_assertion: TypeScript compiles; interface has all required fields

acceptance_criteria.criterion: computeVerdict returns 'perfect' when weather is sunny, temperature >= 20, wind < 15, UV 3-6, and water quality is good
computeVerdict returns 'skip' when weather is stormy or rainy with high winds
computeVerdict produces a human-readable summary string that mentions key conditions
computeVerdict calculates bestTimeWindow based on tide timing and sunset

tasks.technical_notes: This is pure logic with no React dependency. Use existing WeatherForecast, TideData, and Beach types from @van-beaches/shared. The function should synthesize temperature, wind, precipitation, tide timing, sunset time, UV index, and water quality into a cohesive narrative. Look at the existing BeachScore.computeBeachScore for scoring pattern inspiration, but produce narrative text instead of a numeric score. The summary should read like editorial writing, not data labels.
